additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Mr. Yacine from Engie raised this ticket regarding a DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 error. It's possible that one sensor's cable might not properly attached. Please measure the resistance from the points below, if the resistance is the same as you see in the logs (you can enable this here)
:
Points to measure:
If the resistance is correct please remove the cables and plug them back in and let's monitor. If you see this 15ºC difference on-site and by removing the cables and plugging back in it doesn't work, please proceed with the replacement.
